title: Michael's medical exam and injection (sodium pentothal)
place_text: Ellsworth AFB medical facility, South Dakota

tellings.quote: I just remember I just remember they shot some some in me uh something in my vein and stuff and uh

plain: In 1977, at the medical facility of Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota, an Air Force airman named Michael Johnson was examined and given an injection in his vein, which the story identifies as sodium pentothal, a sedative sometimes called a truth serum. Johnson, one of several veterans who say they were abducted by aliens while stationed at the base, tells Michels he only remembers that "they shot something in my vein." Told this way, it would suggest that someone on the base tried to dull or probe the men's memories.
